Frequently asked questions

How do I order from Stermont Arcade?

Add items to your cart on the website, enter your name and delivery details, and place your order. We confirm stock and the delivery fee, then you pay by M-Pesa.

Do you deliver countrywide in Kenya?

Yes. We deliver to all 47 counties in Kenya, usually in 1-3 days. The delivery fee, if any, is confirmed before you pay.

How do I pay?

Pay by M-Pesa using our Paybill details shown after you place your order. Your order is processed once payment is received.

What can I buy at Stermont Arcade?

Phones and tablets, TVs and audio, appliances, health and beauty, home and office, fashion, shoes, bags, computing, gaming, supermarket, baby products, automotive, music gear and agrovet supplies.

What if an item is faulty or not what I ordered?

Message us on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we will arrange a replacement or refund.

Orders, returns and privacy

How orders work

Place your order on the website through the cart. We confirm stock, the total and the delivery fee before you pay. Your order is processed once payment is received.

Returns and refunds

If an item arrives faulty, damaged or different from what you ordered, message us on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund.

Privacy

We use your name, phone number and delivery details only to process and deliver your order. We do not sell your information. Read our full shipping, returns and privacy pages.
